entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: They really did it![n]The Phantom Thieves did it!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom really did have a change of heart!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: When I got home, my mom cooked[n]dinner. She made my favorite,[n]hamburger steak!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Then she admitted that she was [n]wrong and apologized to me for[n]getting so mad about everything.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She broke down crying and told me[n]that she'll be a better mother from[n]now on...
I'm glad to hear that.[clr 27]
That's hard to believe.
Thank the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's all thanks to the Phantom Thieves...[n]and you, [lName]-san.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I know... but it's true.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She's back to how she used to be...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah, I will!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But you played a big part in this too,[n][lName]-san.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I guess winning and losing doesn't[n]matter when it comes to just being[n]happy.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, isn't it true?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The reason my mom was able to change[n]is that she lost to the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Losing wasn't the end at all.[n]It brought my real mom back.[n]Man, I'm so happy right now.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Am I weird... for feeling happy about[n]losing? I mean, all I cared about before[n]was winning.
A little bit, yeah.
No, that makes sense.
It means you've matured.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, you bully!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Whatever. I'm feeling great.[n]You get a free pass.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Really?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, if you say so, then it's gotta be true!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: R-Really!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, you might be right...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Looking back at how obsessed[n]I was with winning, I can see[n]I was just acting like a kid.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wanna get stronger. Strong enough[n]so that I can protect my mom...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I realized something from you and[n]the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Instead of destroying others,[n]protecting and saving people[n]is what makes a person strong.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You listened to my problems, and[n]even confronted my mom for me...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I-I guess that was pretty cool of you...
I feel Shinya's[n]brotherly affection...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: By the way, do you remember[n]Takekuma? The pro who beat me?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I heard more rumors that he uses[n]illegal armor.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wonder why he's cheating...
He wants to win at all costs.[clr 27]
He's too lazy to practice.
I wouldn't know...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah... I kinda understand how he feels.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I might've cheated too, if I had[n]known how.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But getting better is the fun part.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I kinda understand how he feels[n]though.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I might've cheated too, if I had[n]known how.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Well, you'd never do anything like that,[n]so I'm not surprised.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...I kinda understand how he feels[n]though.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I might've cheated too, if I had[n]known how.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...But I don't feel like that at all anymore!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Okay, I'm gonna head home.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, [lName]-san, are the[n]Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Never mind! Bye!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Let's play again sometime!
